purpose: Measure graph usefulness and relational depth beside raw growth, while classifying every owner teaching unit by real activation state.

ownerActivation.rule: Ask quotation alone is not activation. Activated requires a concrete production primitive; contextual teaching stays contextual.

candidateCapacity.rule: Candidates are never deleted merely by age. Active review is bounded; blocked and dormant states preserve useful ideas without pretending they are progressing.

blockedArchitectureDemand.label: Canonical post-incident protocol rehabilitation evidence bundle

utility.why: A causal graph-utility number requires repeatable evaluation where graph traversal itself is the measured treatment. Conversational Cortex A/B evidence must not be relabeled as graph-only utility.
